title: Role-Based Dashboard Differences
description: Four roles, one dashboard, four different experiences — a customer sees a narrow slice with no controls to move freight, while dispatch sees everything with full control. Map out exactly what each role gets on /tracking in one pass.
successCondition: Logging in as each of the four roles and inspecting /tracking confirms: customer sees only their own shipments (row count matches their own bookings, never another customer's shipment id) and no Actions column; driver sees the full fleet-wide list like dispatch does but also no Actions column (drivers can view, not advance); dispatcher and admin both see every shipment across all customers AND an Actions column with a working Advance button. CSV export is available and functional (downloads a non-empty CSV matching the visible filter) for all four roles, each scoped to what that role is allowed to see.
hints: This requires at least two distinct customer accounts with their own shipments to meaningfully prove the customer-scoping half of the check.
The CSV export shares the same ownership scoping as the table listing — a customer's export should never contain another customer's shipment id, same as the on-screen table.
